_doc: Thúy Vi Tông cast, part 2: the Trúc Cơ (true and inner disciples, stewards).

people.role: True disciple of the Cold Ford Hall; holds the third plot of the Heir's Garden, sown in the salt marsh
people.appearance: Tall and sun-dark, with salt in her braid, a punt-pole of tempered bamboo over her shoulder and her father's squint.
people.backstory: Hướng Vãn Chu grew up on the quays of Hàn Tân Thành with a punt-pole in her hands and her father's war in her ears. She is the coast's first true disciple in a century, and the third name in the Heir's Garden (N-thuy_vi-08). In 1195 she did not plant on the slope at all. She took her plot's seed rice to the salt marsh at the river mouth, where the quays of Lô Khẩu Trấn emptied under the resin tax five hundred years ago (V025), and she is trying to grow spirit rice in brackish water. If it takes, it will feed the whole Cold Ford coast. Her father, Hướng Dạ Đăng (huong_da_dang), tells the coast she is building a granary for the next war. She is not. At the border talks of 1190 she met Đàm Thanh Giang (dam_thanh_giang), the disciple of Tùng Đào's head, and they have met on the river-mouth ice every winter since. She wants a coast where nobody is taxed in something they do not have (A041).
people.wants: To make the salt marsh grow rice, and to end the Cold Ford feud without her father's war.
people.secret: She has met Đàm Thanh Giang every winter since 1190 on the river-mouth ice. She also knows what lies under that ice: the six Tùng Đào patrolmen her father killed in 1172.

people.role: The foundling prodigy of the inner gate; Thiệu Thanh Đài's disciple
people.appearance: A thin young man with quick hands and a fixed look, who wears the plain inner-gate robe with a strip of older green silk sewn inside the collar.
people.backstory: In 1166 a baby was left on the step of the sect's door in Lam Yên Thị on the Green Door Day, wrapped in a strip of green inner-gate silk. Dư Tục Đoạn (du_tuc_doan) found him, and the sect named him from the herb book: Viễn Chí, polygala, 'far ambition'. The name fits him too well. He passed the outer gate's First Leaf at nineteen, the youngest in two centuries, and reached Trúc Cơ at thirty-two, faster than any disciple since the move. Thiệu Thanh Đài (thieu_thanh_dai) took him as her first disciple. He studies her moss plot in the Heir's Garden and cannot understand why she planted something that will lose. He has begun to suspect she means to. He has also been asking quietly in the Furnace Hall whose robe the silk came from. He wants to be head of Thúy Vi, and he does not hide it. He has copied the sewing ledger and tells Thiệu Thanh Đài he has not.
people.wants: To be named heir in his master's place, and to learn who left him on the step.
people.secret: He has found the Furnace Hall's bolt of that silk. Its sewing ledger names the inner disciple Tề Tử Tô as the one who drew a robe from it in 1165.

people.role: Master of the outer gate and its spirit fields
people.appearance: A slow, grey-bearded man who uses his hoe as a staff and as a pointer.
people.backstory: A Pivot farmer's son from Thanh Bách Thành, Phạm Thủ Điền came north in 1080 because he had heard Thúy Vi took Earth roots into its outer gate. It does, and it kept him there for forty years before his Wood caught up. Quyền Thanh Lam (quyen_thanh_lam) made him master of the outer gate and its fields in 1150. He knows every outer disciple's root. He is also the one who tells the Earth-only disciples, kindly, that the inner gate will not open for them. He marks the disciples he likes a half-grade up in the gate ledger.
people.wants: To see one Earth-only outer disciple pass the inner gate in his lifetime.
people.secret: He has marked two Earth disciples a half-grade up in the gate ledger so that they may sit the inner test; if the Hall of Rules audits the ledger it will find his hand.

people.role: Keeper of the seed vault; the first elder's daughter
people.appearance: Round-faced and freckled, with her father's slow walk and a knee that jiggles through every meeting.
people.backstory: The only child of Quyền Thanh Lam (quyen_thanh_lam) and Khổng Đương Quy (khong_duong_quy), born at the new seat in 1120 and named for the wheat her father was sowing that week. She is a steady grower and a poor fighter. She keeps the seed vault. At eighty she is afraid she will never reach Kết Đan, and that her father will die waiting for it.
people.wants: Kết Đan before her father dies, or the courage to stop trying.
people.secret: She was told to burn the seed of the sect's first rice when it failed; instead she plants a single row of it each spring in her mother's herb garden.

people.role: Steward of the Cliff Hall; keeper of the founder's grave and of the old life trees
people.appearance: A stooped, weathered man with two water buckets on a yoke and a voice he almost never uses.
people.backstory: Born to a servant of the Cliff Hall in 1050, Bao Nham Tỉnh has spent a hundred and fifty years on the ridge and gone down the mountain four times. He is its steward. He keeps the founder's grave, the founder's pine and the four hundred life trees of disciples who joined before the move, and he waters every one by hand. When one of those trees dies, he makes the 200 km journey down to the new seat, about two weeks on foot, to tell whoever it belonged to. Cù Thúy Bách (cu_thuy_bach) is the only person he calls by name.
people.wants: To be buried among the life trees he waters.
people.secret: He grafts cuttings from dead disciples' life trees onto living ones so that no one he walks down the mountain to tell will lose a tree; the Hall of Rules would call it fraud of the roll.

people.role: Last disciple of the burned Minh Kính Đường; practises its mirror method under an exception
people.appearance: A pale woman with burn-scarred hands who sits by water whenever she can.
people.backstory: Quản Ảnh Hồ was twenty-eight and the senior disciple of Minh Kính Đường when her master, Giản Chiếu Thanh (gian_chieu_thanh), brought his tribulation down on the hall in 1066 (V033). She came to the seat alone, with his method in her head: a still-water mirror method the lineage does not teach. She has practised it at the seat for 134 years under an exception the Hall of Rules renews every decade. She has sat at Trúc Cơ's late stage for a century and expects to die there.
people.wants: To die by water, still at Trúc Cơ, with the mirror method taught to one person.
people.secret: She is teaching the still-water method to the servant girl who fetches her water, against the exception that forbids her to teach it; the Hall renews the exception next year.

people.role: Keeper of the sect's spirit cattle at Mục Ca Thành; a Trúc Cơ in his last two years
people.appearance: A white-haired, brown-faced herder with a bamboo flute through his belt and no teeth on one side.
people.backstory: Uông Mục Địch was a ten-year-old flute student at Địch Thanh Viện when his master's flute drove a herd of spirit cattle mad and they trampled the halls (V014). He went home to the herders of Mục Ca, and then to Thúy Vi, where Tất Hành Vụ (tat_hanh_vu) taught him. He is 198. A Trúc Cơ's span is two hundred years, and he has failed Kết Đan three times. He plays to the sect's spirit cattle on the cape, and he says he will try once more in spring, with the herd listening. He charges the Mục Ca herders a copper to watch the lead cow bow to his tune.
people.wants: Kết Đan in spring with the herd listening, or a quiet place under the cattle's tree.
people.secret: He has taught the lead cow to bow to one tune and charges the Mục Ca herders a copper to watch.

people.role: Steward of the port house's books at Yên Ba Thành; first cultivator of the Thẩm clan of Bạch Sa
people.appearance: A neat man with ink on his middle finger and an abacus in his sleeve.
people.backstory: Thẩm Tịnh Sa is a grandson of the Thẩm clan of Bạch Sa, whose daughter married into a Yên Ba merchant house in 1040 and made the white sands a trading town (A029). He keeps the port house's books for Diêm Hải Tảo (diem_hai_tao) and knows the price of every pill in every port of the cape. He is the clan's first cultivator, and the clan reminds him of it in every letter. He skims two parts in a hundred from every pill price and sends it to the clan.
people.wants: A clan hall in Bạch Sa with his name on the lintel, paid for with clean books.
people.secret: He keeps a second set of the port house's books in which every pill price is two parts in a hundred high, and sends the difference home to the Thẩm clan; Diêm Hải Tảo has trusted his sums for thirty years.

people.role: The Furnace Hall's senior inner alchemist; a heretic in the making
people.appearance: Thin, sharp-boned and very still, with perilla-purple stains on her fingers.
people.backstory: From the perilla village of Tử Tô Thôn, Tề Tử Tô is the Furnace Hall's senior inner alchemist and Úy Thanh Diễm's (uy_thanh_diem) best brewer of wound pills. She is quick, cold and admired. In 1165 she went into a year's closed-door cultivation and came out thin. The next spring a baby was left at the sect's door in Lam Yên Thị (kien_vien_chi). She has never looked at him in a hall. In the Furnace Hall's sealed shelf she has found the Rotting Canopy Canon the sect forbids, and she reads it at night. One batch in forty of her wound pills carries a trace of the forbidden canon, and she does not tell the patients.
people.wants: To finish reading the Rotting Canopy Canon before the sealed shelf is found open.
people.secret: She is copying the forbidden canon into her wound-pill recipes a line at a time, and one batch in forty carries a trace of it; Dư Tục Đoạn's patients are drinking it.

people.role: The founder's last blood, kept on the ridge by the Cliff Hall
people.appearance: A slight young woman with the founder's long eyes, which everyone on the ridge tells her.
people.backstory: A great-great-granddaughter of Phùng Yên Hà (phung_yen_ha) and Âu Dương Thanh Lô (au_duong_thanh_lo), born on the ridge and raised by Cù Thúy Bách (cu_thuy_bach), who sees the founder in her face. The Cliff Hall treats her as a relic, and she hates it. She wants to go down to the new seat and grow magnolias like any other disciple. Cù will not hear of it. She tells Cù Thúy Bách she sleeps early, and slips down the mountain.
people.wants: To go down to the new seat and grow magnolias like any other disciple.
people.secret: One night a month she walks down the mountain to the new seat and back before dawn, and Bành Lạp Mai lies in her bed to cover for her.
